say:1:1620758301:0.text: How are you feeling? Any lingering effects from the love potion?
say:1:1620758301:0.source_cn: 怎么样，你身体还好吗？有感觉到爱情魔药的残留吗？

say:2:1620758302:0.text: What I drank just now was a love potion? Oh no... I really messed up...
say:2:1620758302:0.source_cn: 我刚刚喝下的是爱情魔药？糟了……我、我做错事了……

say:4:1620758304:1.text: Because I wanted to surprise her, I confessed to Rayna publicly, more than once. She never accepted, of course...
say:4:1620758304:1.source_cn: 我以前为了制造“惊喜”，曾冒昧地向蕾娜公开表白过好几次...

say:5:1620758305:1.text: It hit me just now. Real love isn't a one-sided infatuation, it's a mutual connection. But I barely even knew her at the time, yet I blurted out a confession in front of everyone. I must've made things so hard for her...
say:5:1620758305:1.source_cn: 刚才我突然明白过来，真正的爱情不是一厢情愿，而是双方的...

say:6:1620758306:1.text: I'm going to apologize to Rayna right now. Thanks for your concern.
say:6:1620758306:1.source_cn: 我决定了，我现在就去向蕾娜道歉！谢谢你们的关心！

say:8:1620758307:1.text: Huh. Never thought a love potion could have that kind of effect.
say:8:1620758307:1.source_cn: 欸……没想到爱情魔药还有这样的功效啊。
